notes.title: Genetic Disaster : Mutations
notes.content:
For the past months we have been updating the game but now is the time for the big one, a time for big changes. 2.0 is here. Please, welcome Genetic Disaster: Mutations.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30684269/fa27b19f7024e01a1645f4ad35f65cabe88323ce.png
Mutations are powerups and abilities you can put on your character. They can be looted during any run you make. Some of them are common quality and other are rare or even legendary so you probably want to explore every inch of the map. Then you will be able to choose them in the lobby before every game:  Move speed increased for close allies, Improving ghost damages, fire rate increased… more than 30 different mutations are waiting for you..
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30684269/f6d20bd3ca1f53bf186b1c7d3b7fd30e271e63bd.png
After bosses, you'll find 3 upgrades that are different for every character. Increasing Bunker’s shield size, Panic’s stun zone or explosion after each teleportation for Sneaky... every upgrade costs crystals so choose wisely!
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30684269/d262155cd84f3f7231e54a2738c754990b17e584.png
Founded in all kind of chests and sometimes on enemies they can be saved and become permanent (even between games). You’ll need them to buy mutations or upgrades. 
What are you going to do? Banking them for another game, or use them instantly for an upgrade?

A bank is a rare room that you can find in any level. If you get a game over before banking the crystals, you will lose them.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30684269/97799488d95bdf233f91b77d7749a49bf58a14f1.png
There are now 3 differents difficulty mods:
Easy mode: a walk in the park with less aggressive and skilled enemies
Normal mode: it’s the level of difficulty you have experienced so far in Genetic Disaster.
Hard mode: Bigger, faster and stronger enemies… but more crystals to find. Be brave.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30684269/58cfd2fdd86b0fa2e723e50cfb4f4894e4115928.png
It’s a PvP mode, a game mode from 2 to 4 players in an arena. No guns but only stools and some random power ups. People having been hurt and friendships have been broken during development. Beware.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30684269/a699a4ad073c44e83936a5aab1a4d6783bb1ff9b.png
5 new enemies have been created by the mad scientist and each of them got is very special: area of effect shooter, crazy-gatling-gunner-shooter, melee sprinter… They will definitely give you a hard time.
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30684269/450955c348f3e5ce730c876ca9ba8c8637937b25.png
Camera calibration rework
Environments 2 & 3 optimized
3 new items in the shop
Weapons price changed
Health potion price changed
Weapons power balanced
Ammo numbers and drop rate balanced
New rooms and Safe level added
10 new weapons added

And much more changes you’ll have to discover in game!

So basically you now have to run in hard mode through the levels with new stupidly overpowered enemies searching for crystals to buy the insane mutations and have a chance to defeat the bosses.
Sounds fun ; for the scientist I mean.

notes.title: Patch Note 1.2.28 - 25 June 2018
notes.content:
Hey buddies,

We are working hard on Genetic Disaster to offer you the best experience alone or with your friends. We fixed and added a lot of features!
Hope you’ll like it :)

 Patch note for version 1.2.28 
June 25th 2018

 News :

First boss makeover! 
          His bombs take more time to explode
          He’s faster and keeps his chains attack for the second phase
          He can rebuild his shield while teleporting
Tanks have less hp
Hugeeee revive feedback (you won't miss it!)
Ghosts can now use levers and pressure plates to help allies
You can’t revive a friend with less than one heart (you have to offer half of your life)
Cycles duration and enemies HP depend now on the number of player
Bombs are invulnerable to bullets
Throw an object on a barrel will make it.. EXPLODE
You can carry a bomb, it won't explode in your hand 
You can throw an object with A or E too
Need to spam a bit more in order to fill the stun gauge
Legendary weapons are now yellow, rare weapons are violet 
Menu interaction fixed:
         You can’t lose the focus with a gamepad
         Highlight only one element
         New hotkeys
         Option -> Cancel button properly cancel!
Melee range increase on every character 
Add new sounds ingame 
Add stage number on the minimap, in case you’re lost 
Add 2 new start rooms 
Brand new credits list available on the menu
Panic : Ability reworked : his AOE is bigger and stuns every enemies inside. He’s more controllable while running
Devil : Under ability power, he destroys everything, even objects


 Tweaks : 

Porcupines movements are smarter 
We've added some brains cells on enemies : They target players in priority and stop commit suicide
Crab Double Bullet animation is faster. 2 times faster :D
Tanks (Level 4 monsters) shoot 2 times faster
Basic Crabs move faster
Enemies projectiles are more readable
Ghosts have now a contour like usable object when an ally is near
Sneaky : He’s immune while teleporting
	          His teleportation is 3 hundredth of seconds faster (GAME CHANGING)
Panic has a feedback when his ability is recharged 
Fire FX has been accentuate : Burn, baby!
Some weapons : add balance and FX 
GameOver animation is a bit more long, so you can enjoy it :D
Improvement of arena patterns


 Fixes : 

42 fixes about elements synchronisation in multiplayer online
Cycles animations fixed
Death lever feedback is now synchronized
Black bands adapt now on different resolutions
In very specific case, Sneaky was really small. It won't happen again!
You can’t kill your ally with a bomb in the elevator (I know you tried!)
Fix some doors pattern which activate or deactivate too soon
Music fixed
Steam avatar loads properly in the lobby

notes.title: Patch note - 1.1.28 - 25 May 2018
notes.content:
Hey buddies,

While we are still working on the update for the hard mode, here a bunch of fixes to improve your game experience. 
Please enjoy!
Cheers.


Patch note for version 1.1.28
May 25th 2018

Fixes:

 Bombs caught at the last seconds before blowing, get extra time before exploding when launching them
 Performances upgraded for environments 2 and 3
 Double turret (heading bullets) can't be interrupted anymore
 Shop: synchronisation server/client improoved
 Weapon shop now get destroyed properly
 Devil: no longer stacking to infinite and beyond. Cap at 15.
 Boss 2: everyone can now carry eggs
 Door of every boss now has a better colision
 Covers and objects on the map in environment 2 and 3 fit their colision boxes
 Timer now display the correct time


 Tweaks:

 Turrets projectils now stay longer before fading out
 Camera behavior change in level 10
 Cycle without effect doesn't show any anything in the cycle's name
 Camera focus improved
 Camera moves slower while focusing on a room
 Improved bullets readability and visibility
 Sneaky: free bullet when reloading shoots a lot faster
 Sneaky: damages augmented
 Sneay: free bullet readability reworked
 Lever of death room now got FXs
 Odds to destroy the shop tweaked
 Boss 2: improved death feedback
 Melee attack when out of ammo has a better FX
 Boss 1: chains now has more HPs



New:

 In the options you can now show/hide a marker over character's heads
 Cycle FriendlyFire now has a feedback over the entire screen
 During Boum's cycle, ennemies got a flag on them indicating they are going to explode
 Added a special room just before a boss
 Perk "Max ammo" now also give 2 bullet clips
 Each cycle now has a dedicated icon
 Boss 1: feedback when dead
 Boss 1: screenshake on death
 Screenshake when breaking the shops
 Screenshake on elevator
 Ghosts: feedback when resurrecting a friend

notes.title: It's patch day! Version 1.0.2393
notes.content:
Hey mates,

we have released a second patch fixing many issues from tiny insignificant glitches to critical bugs preventing you from enjoying the game. Most of the work is about the multiplayer, first boss and the weapon's distribution (rom now you shouldn't be able anymore to loot a legendary wepons at level 1....that was kinda broken).

There is still issues, problems, bugs and things to improve so we are working on it in between familly diners and press interview.

Stay tuned for further patches in the weeks to come.
Very merry Cristmas to you, band of happy triggers!
